verdict.rationale: Inviting an external accountant with role-scoped access is a fair question for accounting software, but the evidence pack never documents user invitations, accountant access or role-based permissions. The only scoping evidence covers API token scopes for developers, which is an adjacent building block and not the collaboration capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books
